name: flowna-capacitor-ui
description: Capacitor-ready Flowna Music Player HTML interface reference.

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "Flowna Music Player" "com.flowna.musicplayer" --web-dir www
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
